entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 09-07-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.22 of 2024 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 376(D), 504 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
3. The petitioner is accused of committing gang rape with the victim.
4. Considering the nature of allegation levelled against the petitioner, I am not inclined to grant bail to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41314 of 2025(2) dt.09-07-2025 petitioner.
Accordingly, this bail application is rejected.
The trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as early as possible.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) pawan/-
